verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers admin console features (SSO, device management, reports, directory API, Context-Aware Access) but contains no documentation of issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials specifically for an AI agent (e.g., OAuth scope restriction, service-account key minting, or agent-specific credential issuance). Context-Aware Access (google-workspace-docs-15, google-workspace-docs-28) governs app access policies, not credential issuance for agents.
